photos.name: buns-proofed-in-oven
photos.summary: 12 buns proofed in muffin tin, sitting in the oven. Significantly puffed up, glossy golden-orange surface from egg wash. Dough has risen well above the tin edges.

photos.name: crumb-shot-torn-bun
photos.summary: Hand holding a torn-open bun showing bright yellow crumb from gochujang and egg. Fine, cottony texture with visible pull-apart strands. Sesame seeds on the crust. Crumb is tight but soft — enriched dough character.

photos.name: dough-balls-in-muffin-tin
photos.summary: 12 shaped dough balls in a standard muffin tin, pre-bake. Warm orange tint from gochujang, light flour dusting. Uniform portioning, dough sitting about halfway up each cup.

photos.name: glazed-bun-plated-sesame
photos.summary: VSCO-edited hero shot — single glazed bun on decorative black-and-white plate in foreground, topped with black and white sesame seeds. Glossy honey-soy glaze catching the light. Remaining buns visible in tupperware behind. Tall muffin-tin shape, deep golden-brown crust.

photos.name: glazed-buns-in-tupperware
photos.summary: All 12 finished buns piled in a clear tupperware container. Golden brown with glossy honey-soy glaze. Round uniform shape from muffin tin — taller than wide, almost brioche-like profile.
